title: Small Grants Programme 2027: Application Form
key_sentences: The Small Grants Programme funds community projects in Fernshire with awards of up to £3,000.
Please read the guidance notes before completing this form.
Since March 2025 our volunteers have repaired lamps, toasters, bicycles and clothing for local residents in the village hall.
Sessions are free, and visitors learn to carry out simple repairs themselves.
We now want to meet every month instead of every second month, and to train four volunteers to test electrical items safely.
Last year 312 people brought items to our sessions, and two thirds of them were over sixty.
We estimate that the extra sessions will keep about two tonnes of goods out of landfill each year.
Give the full cost of the project and show how much you are asking the Foundation to pay.

rows: Dr Amara Okonkwo-Hale, Chair of trustees
The Old Forge, Mill Lane Millbrook, Fernshire FN4 2PL
Soldering stations, sewing machine, spare parts
Electrical safety testing course for four volunteers
Public liability cover for one year

list_items.text: Write clearly in black or blue ink, or complete the form on screen.
Answer every question; write “not applicable” where a question does not apply.
Attach your most recent annual accounts and a copy of your safeguarding policy.
Return the form by 15 January 2027 to grants@fernhollow.example.
(i) the information in this application is true and complete;
(ii) the organisation has a bank account that needs two signatures;
(iii) any grant will be spent only on the project described above;
(iv) we will send the Foundation a short report within three months of the project ending.
